name: Feldon's Cane
description: A mystical cane marked with unknown runes that was not made by the Thran; last seen when Feldon traded it to a black mage.

description_citations.text: "Feldon". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: On an expedition Feldon finds a mystical cane with unknown runic symbols.
timeline.quote: In one expedition, he found a mystical cane marked with unknown runic symbols.

citation.text: "Feldon", section "Early years". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: A black mage teaches Feldon a spell in exchange for his cane, but it creates a zombified Loran; Feldon unsummons it and the mage vanishes with the cane.
timeline.quote: Disgusted, Feldon unsummoned the creature before he could lay eyes on it, but by then the black mage had disappeared completely.
